title: Question 25
passage:
I left my reading glasses at home. I can’t make out this menu.
A. I usually sit near the front window. B. I can read it out to you. Which section do you want first? C. They’ve used the same menu since June.
passageZh:
我把老花眼鏡忘在家裡了，看不清楚這份菜單。
A. 我通常坐在前面的窗戶旁。 B. 我可以念給你聽。你想先聽菜單的哪個部分？ C. 他們從六月起就一直用同一份菜單。
